additions.name: cup
additions.definition: A small open vessel for drinking or holding ingredients; not a calibrated measuring cup.

additions.name: cauldron
additions.definition: A large rounded cooking pot, traditionally used over a fire; no specific regional vessel equivalence is asserted.

additions.name: clay casserole
additions.definition: A casserole vessel made of clay. Heat-source suitability depends on the particular vessel; clay does not imply stovetop safety.

additions.name: work surface
additions.definition: A surface used for preparing food or working dough; does not identify a particular board, table or material.

additions.name: stove
additions.definition: A kitchen cooking appliance providing heat to cookware; no equivalence to an oven or a specific fuel is implied.

additions.name: teaspoon
additions.definition: A small spoon for stirring, serving or handling food. Not a calibrated measuring spoon or a unit definition.

additions.name: squeeze bottle
additions.definition: A squeezable bottle with a dispensing opening for applying sauces or other liquids.

additions.name: mixing bowl
additions.definition: A bowl used for combining ingredients, without any implied material or heat resistance.

additions.name: microwave oven
additions.definition: An appliance that heats food using microwave energy; distinct from the microwave process.

additions.name: platter
additions.definition: A broad serving dish for presenting food; not implicitly oven-safe.

additions.name: return
additions.definition: Move something back to a previous place or vessel; not a cooking technique.

additions.name: enjoy
additions.definition: A conventional invitation to enjoy the finished food; not a transformation.

additions.name: push
additions.definition: Move by applying pressure in the specified direction; not a defined cooking technique.

additions.name: eat
additions.definition: Consume the food; an ordinary action, not a preparation technique.

additions.name: roll out
additions.definition: Flatten dough or pastry into a sheet by rolling. Distinct from rolling into a log or coating by rolling.

additions.name: butter
additions.definition: Apply butter to food or a vessel surface. Retains the specific coating material rather than aliasing all greasing.

additions.name: oil
additions.definition: Apply oil to food or an equipment surface. Does not imply frying or a particular oil.

additions.name: flour
additions.definition: Apply flour to food or a working surface; distinct from generic dusting with any powder.

additions.name: pat dry
additions.definition: Remove surface moisture by gentle contact with an absorbent material; not dehydration or generic patting.

additions.name: juice
additions.definition: Extract juice from produce; distinct from expressing aromatic peel oil.

additions.name: sieve
additions.definition: Pass material through a sieve to separate particles; may concern dry powders or liquids, without equating every straining method.
